protocol.source: SeG BVH rendered as corrected SOMA mesh
protocol.target: retargeted G1 front and side videos
protocol.prompt: literal-only v1; no SeG label or description prior

results.source_soma_literal: Right arm bends and lifts forward across the abdomen, hand turning thumb-up with fingers curled, pauses before the pelvis, then lowers once as the torso tilts right.
results.g1_literal: The right arm bends once, lifting the forearm forward and diagonally across the torso to chest height, then lowers palm-up before straightening beside the hip.

results.source_soma_literal: Both arms lift forward with elbows bent, bringing curved fingers together directly before the eyes, hold this position briefly, then lower apart toward the sides.
results.g1_literal: Both arms lift forward from the sides, elbows bending as curved hands converge in front of and above the forehead, briefly hold, then lower.

results.source_soma_literal: Both hands rise forward to face level with elbows bent, repeatedly flexing and extending the index and middle fingers while held apart.
results.g1_literal: Both arms rise forward with elbows bent, holding hands in front of the face as the index and middle fingers repeatedly bend and straighten, then lower.

results.source_soma_literal: Right arm lifts forward from the side to eye level, with elbow slightly bent, wrist flexed and fingers hanging downward, pauses, then lowers.
results.g1_literal: The right arm lifts forward and bends, positioning a flexed wrist and downward-pointing fingers near the face, holds briefly, then lowers.

results.source_soma_literal: Both forearms lift forward to chest height; the right wrist bends downward with curved fingers above the partially closed left hand, then both lower.
results.g1_literal: Both arms lift forward with elbows bent, forearms crossing before the upper chest; the right hand rises near the face as this pose is maintained.

results.source_soma_literal: Right arm bends upward and forward, bringing a closed fist near the shoulder, then extends forward as the hand opens and lowers.
results.g1_literal: The right arm lifts forward with the elbow bent, bringing gathered fingertips near the face; the pose is held briefly before the fingers spread and arm lowers.

results.source_soma_literal: Both forearms lift forward to chest height with elbows bent, while the curled hands repeatedly alternate vertically, one hovering above the other.
results.g1_literal: Both arms lift forward with bent elbows, while the separated hands repeatedly alternate vertically in front of the torso, then both arms lower.

results.source_soma_literal: Right arm lifts forward from the side to shoulder height as the elbow straightens and fingers curl, briefly holds, then lowers again.
results.g1_literal: The right arm bends and lifts forward from beside the hip to shoulder height, pauses with an open hand, then lowers.

results.source_soma_literal: The right hand and forearm lift forward to rest against the right side of the head while the head tilts right and torso bends, hold, then lower.
results.g1_literal: Right arm lifts with elbow bent until the hand is slightly forward of and beside the face, thumb and index forming a ring, holds, then lowers.

results.source_soma_literal: The right arm bends and lifts forward, holding a curled hand just before the mouth for several moments, then lowers.
results.g1_literal: The right arm bends forward and upward, holding the hand close before the face as fingers shift from curled to partly extended, then lowers.

results.source_soma_literal: Both arms lift and bend forward until the splayed hands contact the waist, holding the elbows laterally while the head tilts left.
results.g1_literal: Both arms bend simultaneously, bringing open hands forward and inward onto the upper hips with elbows flared outward, maintaining contact, then extending downward.

results.source_soma_literal: Both arms lift forward, fold across the chest with forearms overlapping, and hold while the torso and head lean left and knees bend slightly.
results.g1_literal: Both arms bend and lift forward until the forearms overlap across the chest, with one open palm upright, maintaining the pose before lowering.

results.source_soma_literal: Left arm bends to lift the hand near the mouth with index finger extended, briefly holds, then reaches forward as the palm turns upward and fingers open.
results.g1_literal: Left arm lifts forward, bends to hold the hand near the face with index and thumb extended, then straightens forward and lowers.

results.source_soma_literal: Left arm lifts forward from the side to above the head with elbow bent and fingers spread as the head tilts toward it, then lowers once.
results.g1_literal: The left arm lifts forward and upward, bends to place the open palm close before the face, briefly holds, then lowers to the side.

results.source_soma_literal: The left arm lifts forward to head height with elbow bent and fingers curved, while the right hand rises close beneath it, then both lower.
results.g1_literal: The left arm lifts forward above head height with a curved open hand, then the right hand rises close beneath it, briefly holding before both lower.

results.source_soma_literal: The right arm lifts forward, bends at the elbow to position the open hand above and slightly forward of the forehead, holds, then lowers.
results.g1_literal: The right arm lifts forward once from the side to above the head, remains bent overhead with an open curved hand, then lowers.

results.source_soma_literal: Left arm bends and lifts forward once, placing the spread hand against the forehead and eyes as the head tilts right, holds, then lowers.
results.g1_literal: Left arm lifts forward with the elbow bent, holding an open, outward-facing hand near the head that oscillates side-to-side before lowering.

results.source_soma_literal: Left arm bends upward and forward, bringing the partially curled hand close to the mouth, holds there briefly, then lowers back beside the torso.
results.g1_literal: Left arm bends and lifts forward until the open hand is held close before the forehead, then lowers back beside the torso.

results.source_soma_literal: Both arms lift forward with elbows bent as the open, spread-fingered hands rise from waist to chest level and turn toward each other.
results.g1_literal: Both arms lift forward from the sides with elbows bent and open palms, briefly cross near the waist, then separate toward face level before lowering.

results.source_soma_literal: The right arm lifts forward to shoulder height, extending with the palm facing outward and fingers spread, holds briefly, then lowers.
results.g1_literal: The right arm lifts forward with elbow bent, raising an open, forward-facing palm to head height, holds briefly, then lowers to the side.
